name: Lucky Penny Fishing Charters
summary: Lucky Penny Fishing Charters runs inshore and offshore fishing trips from Shallow Draught in Bridgetown. Skipper and owner Danny and a local crew fish aboard a 32-foot Luhrs that takes up to six guests. Trips run from four hours of light tackle to a full day offshore, and are booked by phone or email.
standouts: 32-foot Luhrs with twin 370 HP Yanmar engines, cruising at up to 24 knots
Air-conditioned cabin, flybridge and a fighting chair
Local crew who grew up fishing these waters

trips.title: Four Hour Light Tackle Trip
trips.summary: A four-hour light tackle fishing trip from Bridgetown. The captain tailors the trip to the group, and it suits beginners and families bringing children fishing for the first time.
highlights: Suits beginners and families with children

trips.summary: A six-hour deep-sea trip offshore for marlin and other big game. The boat carries outriggers, downriggers, a live bait well and a fighting chair.
